entities.summary: Fire of Anatolia and Troy in Serik, Türkiye, are large evening dance productions combining ensemble choreography, costume, music and historical stories.
entities.description: At Gloria Aspendos Arena in Serik, Antalya, Türkiye, Fire of Anatolia or Troy presents large dance ensembles in a focused evening spectacle. Traditional and contemporary movement, music and costume carry mythic and historical imagery with little dependence on spoken language. Book the exact production and reconfirm date and venue; do not assume a nightly show or a performance in the ancient Aspendos theatre.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Fire of Anatolia and Troy in Türkiye create a strong visual evening through unusually large dance ensembles, costume and musical storytelling.
